mira: FYI a customer pinged support: console shows v2 p95 spike but billing lists tokens under v1. digging into routing_events we see "fallback_path=degenerate->v1" during a short capacity blip.
owen: degenerate fallback = when no compatible v2 variant exists and policy picks best-effort v1. we added that for availability but forgot to make it explicit in telemetry.
tal: fix plan: 1) emit a canonical model_resolution event per request: {request_id, requested_model, resolved_model, resolve_reason, serve_region_coarse}. 2) make billing join on request_id so attribution is unambiguous.
mira: product asks: we need console UI to surface % of resolved_model != requested_model per-tenant and ability to download example traces. also banner copy for affected tenants.
deploy-bot: infra-note: kafka schema change scheduled; add optional fields to routing_events topic. consumers should tolerate new fields.
owen: avoid high-cardinality: use serve_region_coarse values: same_region, cross_region, cross_cloud and keep raw region only in sampled spans.
tal: short SQL for alerting: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(billed_tokens) billed, sum(served_tokens) served
FROM billing_events JOIN model_resolution USING(request_id)
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING abs(billed - served) > 0 AND abs(billed - served) / GREATEST(billed, served) > 0.01;
```
cassie: SDK thought: add header x-rw-fallback-behavior: allow/notify/deny. default notify for new SDKs, allow for server-to-server. need console toggle per-tenant.
mira: timeline: telemetry + billing join (week 1), console panel + banner (week 2), SDK header + tenant toggle (week 4).
owen: I'll prototype model_resolution schema and a sampled trace link.
tal: I'll own dual-write for billing while reconciliation runs for 2 weeks.
cassie: I'll draft banner and console copy.
mira: cheers — please keep RFC short. we'll review in eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
